variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.body: A strike has collapsed in {colony}. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.body: The colony has seen a strike collapse. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.body: A strike in the colony has ended in collapse. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
